newsitem.title: POLAND: Swedish Alcro-Beckers calls tender for Polish firm.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Alcro-Beckers calls tender for Polish firm.

text.p: Swedish paint firm Alcro- Beckers AB, which on Friday called a public tender offer to buy the remaining shares in Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica at 89 zlotys, has no plans to de-list Polifarb, Alcro-Beckers said.
Polifarb Debica's 700,000-share initial public offering earlier this year at 65 zlotys per share was oversubscribed and the firm seeks a main-market listing on the Warsaw bourse.
"Withdrawing the firm from bourse trade is not planned," an Alco-Beckers representative in Poland, Dariusz Marzec, told daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki in its Saturday edition.
Alcro-Beckers, which currently holds nearly 0.3 percent of Polifarb shares, has offered to buy Polifarb's remaining 2,029,436 shares from July 25 to August 22.

In May Poland's Securities Commission (KPW) said it had no objection to plans by Alcro-Beckers to buy a stake in Polifarb Debica that would give it more than 50 percent of votes at shareholders' meetings.
Currently National Investment Fund (NFI) No 11 holds a 32-percent stake in Polifarb Debica.
NFI 11 President Janusz Palucki told daily Parkiet in its Saturday edition that he could not yet say if the fund would answer the call or how many shares it might want to sell.
